Khushbo Talash Karti Thi Chahat Jo Phol Ki.
Do Sadiqon Ki Aik Hai Saat Nazool Ki.

1
Utra Hai Aaftab-e-Sadaqat Zameen Par.
Humrah Roshni Hai Khuda Ke Rasool Ki.
Ilm-o-Kamal-o-Taqwa Sadaqat Ke Wirsa Daar.
Nazrein Jami Hain Inn Pe Har Ik Dil-e-Malool Ki.

2
Woh Shaks Badshahon Ki Tauqeer Rakhta Hai.
Jis Ne Bhi Inn Ke Dar Ki Ghulami Qabool Ki.
Masoom Aathwein Hain Imam Shasham Hain Yeh.
Tareekh Likh Gaye Hain Faro-o-Usool Ki.

3
Inn Ki Sadaqaton Pe Sadaqat Ko Naaz Hai.
Yeh Bhi Hain Ik Nishani Jahan Mein Rasool Ki.
 Rehan Haq Kalami Qalam Ko Atta Hoi.
Daad-e-Sukhanwari Bhi Inhi Se Wasool Ki.

import pathlib, subprocess
p = pathlib.Path('src/data/lyrics/khushbo-talash-karti-thi-chahat-jo-phol-ki-tajpoints-943f6a379471161368db.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
normalize = lambda s: [line.strip().removesuffix('.').lower() for line in s.splitlines()]
assert normalize(old) == normalize(roman)
blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
assert [block[0] for block in blocks[1:]] == list('۱۲۳')
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified Roman wording and Urdu stanza layout.')
PY"

Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have the same two-verse preamble and three four-verse stanzas.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed `noUrdu`. Read the ambiguous Roman “Faro” as `فروع` in `فروع و اصول`.
